description: List data streams for a GA4 property (web, Android, iOS). Web streams include the measurement ID and default URI; app streams include package name / bundle ID. Use this to audit measurement IDs and stream config. Read-only.

maxPages.description: Maximum number of API pages to fetch (default 50). If more pages remain, the result includes truncated:true and a nextPageToken.

pageToken.description: Continuation token to resume listing from a previous truncated result.

name: ga4_data_streams_list
